statement: Realty Income Corporation reported a 98.7% occupancy rate at the end of FY2024 Q3.

M&T Bank Corporation repurchased 1,190,054 shares of its common stock during FY2024 Q3 at an average cost per share of $166.40, resulting in a total cost of $200 million including the share repurchase excise tax.
Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s effective tax rate was 19.7% for the three months ended September 28, 2024.
PPG Industries, Inc. recorded an impairment charge of $146 million in the fourth quarter 2024 related to the classification of its remaining operations in Russia as held for sale.
The fourth quarter 2024 impairment charge did not result in a tax benefit for PPG Industries, Inc.
CSX Corporation's total first half revenue was slightly below original expectations.
The revenue decrease of $23 million was primarily due to lower fuel recovery.
Microsoft Corporation's Dynamics 365 revenue grew 26% in FY2024 Q3 compared with the prior period.
Microsoft's Intelligent Cloud revenue increased $12.9 billion or 20% in FY2024 Q3.
Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 30% in FY2024 Q3.
Microsoft's Gaming revenue increased $4.5 billion or 38% in FY2024 Q3.
3M Company's Industrial Adhesives and Tapes division revenue increased from $516 million in 2023 to $542 million in Q3 2024.
Teledyne Technologies Incorporated’s Instrumentation segment contributed a little under 25% of total net sales in FY2024.

Occidental Petroleum Corp's Low Carbon Ventures team is developing a direct air capture facility (STRATOS) in Ector County, Texas, with BlackRock as a joint venture partner accounting for a non-controlling interest (NCI).

The joint venture for STRATOS involves additional investments from Occidental and BlackRock, with BlackRock committed to invest up to $550 million, and distributions from the joint venture are structured with preferential returns to the NCI up to a threshold before benefiting Occidental.
Verisk Analytics, Inc.'s effective tax rate was 21.6% for the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to 20.3% for the three months ended March 31, 2024.
Assurant, Inc.'s main U.S. program provides nearly $1.8 billion in loss coverage in excess of its retention.
The U.S. per-occurrence catastrophe coverage includes a main reinsurance program with $1.76 billion of coverage in excess of a $160.0 million retention.
The U.S. program, combined with the FHCF, protects against gross Florida losses of up to approximately $2.04 billion in excess of retention.

Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s Products and Systems Integration segment revenue increased 15% in FY2024 Q2, driven by $213 million (19%) growth in LMR and $8 million (3%) growth in Video, inclusive of revenue from acquisitions.

Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s Software and Services segment revenue was flat in FY2024 Q2, partially offset by a $48 million (8%) decrease in LMR due to the exit of ESN and Airwave services revenue reduction.
News Corporation's News Media segment revenue decreased $16 million, or 3%, for the three months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2023.

The decrease in News Media segment revenue was primarily due to lower advertising revenues, which decreased $24 million, or 9%, driven by reduced digital advertising from declining traffic at some mastheads and lower print advertising at News Corp Australia, partially offset by a $5 million positive impact from foreign currency fluctuations.
Vulcan Materials Company's Aggregates segment freight-adjusted revenues increased to $4,636.2 million in FY2024 from $4,461.3 million in FY2023.
The freight-adjusted sales price for Vulcan Materials Company's Aggregates segment was $21.08 per ton in FY2024.
Cboe Global Markets, Inc.'s Data and Access Solutions business had organic net revenue increase 6% year-over-year for the third quarter.
Northern Trust Corporation’s Tier 1 leverage ratio was 8% in FY2024 Q2, up 20 basis points from the prior quarter.
International Business Machines Corporation's Business Transformation revenue increased 1.6 percent in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
International Business Machines Corporation's Technology Consulting revenue decreased 4.0 percent in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
International Business Machines Corporation's Application Operations revenue decreased 1.2 percent in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period.
International Business Machines Corporation's Consulting revenue decreased 0.5 percent year-to-date in the first nine months of 2024 as reported.
Realty Income Corporation achieved a rent recapture rate of 105% on the 170 leases renewed during the period, generating approximately $38 million in new annualized cash rent.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s reinsurance segment contributed $167 million of underwriting income in the 2025 first quarter.
The reinsurance segment's $167 million underwriting income occurred during a quarter with significant catastrophic loss activity.
PACCAR Inc invested $698.3 million in capital projects in 2023.
PACCAR Inc invested $410.9 million in research and development in 2023.
PPG Industries, Inc. completed the sale of 100% of its U.S. and Canada architectural coatings business to American Industrial Partners (AIP) on December 2, 2024.
PPG received $516 million in proceeds from the sale of its architectural coatings business in the fourth quarter 2024.
PPG recorded a $285 million loss on the sale of its architectural coatings business during the fourth quarter 2024.
American Water Works Company, Inc. completed a $800 million long-term debt issuance at a 5.25% coupon in late February 2025.
The $800 million debt issuance generated net proceeds of approximately $792 million after underwriting discounts.
PACCAR Inc invested $679.4 million in capital projects in 2023 compared to $491.2 million in 2022.
PACCAR Inc's combined investments in worldwide capital projects and R&D totaled $7.68 billion over the past decade.
PACCAR Inc is expected to invest $700 to $750 million in capital projects in 2024.
PACCAR Inc is expected to invest $460 to $500 million in R&D in 2024.
PACCAR Inc's 30% share in the Marshall County, Mississippi battery factory partnership is expected to involve $600 to $900 million total investment.

M&T Bank Corporation repurchased 1,190,054 shares of its common stock in FY2024 Q3 at an average cost per share of $166.40, resulting in a total cost of $200 million including the share repurchase excise tax.
3M Company's industrial adhesives and tapes division saw growth primarily driven by bonding solutions for electronic devices.
Cboe Global Markets, Inc.'s Data and Access Solutions business had organic net revenue increase 6% year-over-year for the third quarter.
PACCAR Parts achieved record revenues in the first quarter of FY2025 with gross margins of 30.7%.
IBM Consulting revenue increased 1.1% year-to-date adjusted for currency, reaching $15,517 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2024.

The consulting revenue growth was partially offset by a 0.5% decrease in reported consulting revenue for the third quarter of 2024 compared to the prior-year period, attributed to a challenging macroeconomic environment impacting client buying behavior.
Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s Products and Systems Integration segment's net sales increased $221 million, or 15%, in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.
The Products and Systems Integration segment's net sales included $12 million of revenue from acquisitions in the second quarter of 2024.
Globe Life Inc.'s net investment income increased at a compound annual growth rate of 6% over the three years ending 2024.
The effective annual yield rate earned on Globe Life's fixed maturity portfolio was 5.26% in 2024, compared with 5.20% in 2023.

Globe Life invested approximately $52 million in commercial mortgage loans and limited partnerships with debt-like characteristics, with an average expected cash return of approximately 8.5% for these investments.
Essex Property Trust, Inc.'s core funds from operations attributable to common stockholders and unitholders increased to $1,038,167 in FY2024 compared to $999,907 in FY2023.
Core FFO per share-diluted for Essex Property Trust, Inc. was $15.60 in FY2024, reflecting a 1.3% year-over-year growth as stated in the remarks.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. acquired a 90% ownership interest in Delilah I, a 300 MW solar generating facility in Texas, for approximately $459.0 million in March 2024.
Delilah I is expected to qualify for PTCs and will be included in the non-utility energy infrastructure segment.
APA Corp's receivable balance from the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) has been delayed for periods longer than historically experienced over the past two years.
APA Corp has seen improved receipts in recent quarters for oil and gas sales to EGPC.
APA Corp believes it will be able to collect the total balance of its receivables from EGPC.

As of March 31, 2025, Vistra Corp. posted $1.025 billion in cash and Eligible Assets with counterparties for commodity hedging and trading activities, compared to $841 million as of December 31, 2024.
Vistra Corp. received $5 million in cash from counterparties as of March 31, 2025, compared to $49 million received as of December 31, 2024.
Letters of credit posted with counterparties by Vistra Corp. decreased to $2.439 billion as of March 31, 2025, from $2.560 billion as of December 31, 2024.
Vistra Corp. received $89 million in letters of credit from counterparties as of March 31, 2025, compared to $131 million received as of December 31, 2024.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.'s Banking segment revenue increased 2% for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to 2023.
The Banking segment's revenue growth was driven by a 3% contribution from recurring revenue, primarily due to higher transaction processing revenue.
A decline in non-recurring revenue offset the Banking segment's revenue growth by 1 percentage point for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Abbott Laboratories' Medical Devices segment sales grew 12.5% in FY2025 Q1.
Expedia Group, Inc.'s gross bookings increased 7% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
The increase in gross bookings was primarily driven by lodging gross bookings due to continued strength in the hotel business.
Visa Inc.'s payments volume growth in the International segment was 12% in nominal terms and 10% in constant dollars for the three months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the same period in 2022.
The International segment's payments volume growth in constant dollars was 10% for the three months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the same period in 2022.
IQVIA was awarded a multiyear contract by a large pharma client to deliver its next best action offering for sales reps across 9 countries.
Synopsys, Inc. had $1.3 billion of total unrecognized stock-based compensation expense as of July 31, 2024, expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 2.3 years.
Synopsys, Inc. had $70.3 million of unrecognized stock-based compensation expense from its Employee Stock Purchase Plan as of July 31, 2024, expected to be recognized over approximately 2.0 years.
CME Group Inc. reported a 9% increase in average daily volume of futures and options contracts to 26.9 million in 2024 compared to the previous year.
Tyson Foods, Inc.'s Beef and Pork segments experienced increased pricing, contributing to an increase of $271 million in accounted-for revenue for FY2024 Q3.
The increase in Beef and Pork segments was partially offset by lower average sales prices in the Chicken and Prepared Foods segments.
Oracle Corporation invested $8.9 billion in research and development in fiscal 2024.

Oracle Corporation's investments in research and development focus on improving performance, security, reliability, operation, integration, and cost-effectiveness of offerings, as well as incorporating emerging technologies like AI.
BorgWarner Inc. had a share repurchase authorization of up to $767 million as of April 2024, expiring December 31, 2027.
As of September 30, 2024, BorgWarner Inc. had repurchased $404 million of common stock under its share repurchase program.
Deere & Company's Brazilian equipment sales are expected to decline in FY2024 Q3 due to strong global yields reducing commodity prices and persistently high interest rates.
Deere & Company's Brazilian equipment sales decline is further exacerbated by high interest rates in the region, as noted in the remarks.
Lennox International Inc.'s Building Climate Solutions segment net sales decreased 6% in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.

The decrease in Building Climate Solutions segment net sales was primarily due to lower sales volumes of 9%, partially offset by favorable price and mix of 3% and destocking headwinds from the fourth quarter of 2024 prebuy being offset by stocking of new R-454B products.

Nucor Corporation's wholly owned subsidiary, Nu-Iron Unlimited, is located in Trinidad and benefits from a low-cost supply of natural gas and favorable logistics for inbound iron ore and shipment of DRI to the United States.
Encore Boston Harbor generated $63 million of EBITDAR in the three months ended September 30, 2024.
Encore Boston Harbor's EBITDAR increased 4% year-on-year during the quarter ended September 30, 2024.
J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.'s ICS segment had an operating loss of $13.3 million in the second quarter 2024, compared to an operating loss of $4.4 million in 2023.

The ICS segment's operating loss increase was primarily due to an 11% decrease in gross profit, higher insurance and claims expense, and integration and transition costs related to the purchase of the brokerage assets of BNSF Logistics, LLC.
The ICS segment's gross profit margin increased to 14.8% in the second quarter 2024, compared to 13.0% in 2023.
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s theatrical product revenue decreased 40% for the three months ended September 30, 2024.
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s games revenue decreased 31% for the three months ended September 30, 2024.

NextEra Energy, Inc. and its subsidiaries of NextEra Energy Resources sold a joint venture portfolio of wind and solar generation facilities with approximately 1,600 MW capacity in July 2024 for cash proceeds of approximately $900 million, subject to closing adjustments.

NextEra Energy, Inc. and its subsidiaries of NextEra Energy Resources sold five wind and three solar generation facilities with 688 MW capacity in June 2023 for cash proceeds of approximately $566 million plus $32 million working capital.
Starbucks Corporation's International segment revenue declined 2% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
The decline in Starbucks' International segment was primarily driven by unfavorable foreign currency translation and a 4% decline in comparable store sales due to a 4% drop in average ticket.
Starbucks' Channel Development segment revenue decreased 7% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
The Channel Development segment decline was primarily due to reduced revenue in the Global Coffee Alliance after selling Seattle’s Best Coffee to Nestlé and product SKU optimization.
NRG Energy, Inc. has a share repurchase authorization of $3.7 billion, with $2.0 billion remaining as of October 31, 2024.
Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. paid $11,176 in interest during the nine months ended March 31, 2024.
The Company's effective tax rate was 23.7% for the three months ended March 31, 2024, compared to 23.2% in the prior fiscal year quarter.
The decrease in paid income taxes for the nine months ended March 31, 2024, compared to 2023, was $32,565.
Delta Air Lines, Inc.'s Domestic passenger revenue increased 1% in the March 2025 quarter compared to the March 2024 quarter on a 4% increase in capacity.

REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. anticipates a delay in potential FDA approval of linvoseltamab beyond the August 22, 2024 target action date due to unresolved findings at a third-party fill/finish provider's inspection.
REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. believes the linvoseltamab BLA approval delay is not related to safety, efficacy, or confirmatory trial status.

Global Payments Inc.'s Merchant Solutions segment includes a Core Payments Solutions business that provides payments technology services and other commerce enablement solutions directly to customers and through referral partnerships and wholesale relationships.
Walmart Inc.'s total revenues increased $8.0 billion or 5.2% for the three months ended October 31, 2023, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.

The revenue increase was primarily driven by strong positive comparable sales in the Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club segments, with growth in transactions and average ticket, including strong sales in grocery and health and wellness, and positive comparable sales in most international markets.
International sales grew 5.4% in constant currency, with Walmex sales up more than 9% and China up 25%, driven by strong performance in Sam's Club and e-commerce.
Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.'s organic change in base commissions and fee revenues was 7.5% for the three-month period ended June 30, 2024, compared to 9.6% for the same period in 2023.
The aggregate increase in base commissions and fees for the six-month period ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023, was 17.1%.
